inputs.text: [excited] TOR-oh-SOR-us. [curious] In Greek, "toro," here, means punched-through, holed. Not "bull," even though it sounds like it. And "saurus" is lizard.
[happily] Almost: the lizard with the punched-through frill. [warmly] He lived in North America, sixty-six million years ago, alongside Triceratops.
[warmly] Exactly. A big cousin, with a frill full of holes.
